projects.headline: There’s more to this bike than a spec sheet.
projects.audience: For people who make bikes, race them or love them.
projects.problem: A product page can tell you the parts. We want to give you a reason to look closer.
projects.promise: KONA brings race identity, equipment and place together—from a close look at a bike to a room built around an athlete.
projects.rights: Internal · third-party brands and generated sculpture

projects.headline: What helps me come back stronger?
projects.audience: For people trying to make sense of their training.
projects.problem: Different watches and apps hold different pieces of the same person’s story. Keeping them together becomes another job.
projects.promise: Performance OS connects records from different sources to explore training, recovery and personal context, with an Android companion and a web app.
projects.status: Personal trial · preparing for a comeback race

projects.headline: A museum for the things we make.
projects.audience: For people with a body of work to share.
projects.problem: The work is scattered across files and links. We’re giving people a place to find it.
projects.promise: Studio/AI pairs readable case studies with a walkable museum, arranging work as objects, rooms and connected ideas.

projects.headline: A plaza for everyday life.
projects.audience: For people shaping a place together.
projects.problem: A plan can be hard to picture if you do not read drawings for a living.
projects.promise: Gaudí’s constructive thinking, AI-assisted exploration and a real Barcelona site meet in one competition proposal.
projects.rights: Internal · anonymous competition entry until judging

projects.headline: What if arriving in Kona was part of the game?
projects.audience: For racers, visitors and the people welcoming them.
projects.problem: A map can get you there. We want to play with the feeling of being there.
projects.promise: Kona Island explores walking, riding, collecting and discovering stories around an event destination.
projects.status: Playable world prototype · local and cloud variants

projects.headline: Follow one object into another world.
projects.audience: For people who tell stories through objects.
projects.problem: An object means more when you can discover the world around it.
projects.promise: SŌKAI uses a katana and memory-vault setting to explore identity, ritual and spatial storytelling.

projects.headline: See what changed from one bike to the next.
projects.audience: For people curious about the design of a bicycle.
projects.problem: A list of parts does not show you how a bicycle changed over time.
projects.promise: Canyon Museum uses editable bicycle reconstructions and themed rooms to tell the evolution of performance design.

projects.headline: Start with one bike. Follow its history.
projects.audience: For people curious about how these bikes came to be.
projects.problem: Pictures and notes can be hard to piece together. The first bike gives us a place to start looking closely.
projects.promise: The Trek study connects primary-source research with a part-aware 3D exhibit, starting with an Equinox 9 heritage prototype.
projects.status: Working heritage prototype · wider museum in development

projects.headline: A little of the feeling, before you arrive.
projects.audience: An independent concept inspired by The Belong Festival.
projects.problem: A festival listing can explain the programme without conveying how it might feel to be there.
projects.promise: Scroll through a desert from daylight to night, changing the palette and sound along the way.

projects.headline: NOEMA / Human Meaning Atlas
projects.audience: Research exploration · education · maps of evidence
projects.problem: Research spread across papers is hard to explore across both place and time.
projects.promise: A globe and time lens connect archaeological observations to their sources. Coverage, uncertain geography and interpretation stay distinct.
projects.status: Working research prototype · human review pending

projects.headline: Sintra AI / From curiosity to practice
projects.audience: AI learning · workflow discovery · knowledge portals
projects.problem: AI tools and advice are scattered; finding a useful next step takes work.
projects.promise: A bilingual portal connects tools, prompts, learning material and automation blueprints. Browse the original workflow guides.

projects.headline: CaldaSpace / A small science lesson
projects.audience: Science learning · accessible simulations · space discovery
projects.problem: A chart of starlight means more when you can try finding the planet yourself.
projects.promise: A simple simulated starlight game: a supporting example of learning through play.

projects.headline: What deserves a closer look?
projects.audience: For teams reviewing a table of financial metrics.
projects.problem: A useful warning can get lost in a spreadsheet.
projects.promise: Three clear threshold rules turn example metrics into a small review list.

projects.headline: Let the work keep its trail.
projects.audience: For teams bringing scattered records into a useful answer.
projects.problem: Finding the right source, checking the numbers and explaining the result take time.
projects.promise: FP&A research, reporting connections and source tracking inform how we build tools for finance, training and a growing 3D collection.

projects.headline: Walk a Las Vegas landmark from the lake to the penthouse.
projects.audience: For people who need to feel a place, not just see plans of it.
projects.problem: Pictures and plans are hard to turn into a sense of being in a place.
projects.promise: Bellagio connects the lake and fountains, the Strip, sixteen interiors and an imagined penthouse in one walkable world.
projects.rights: Internal · trademarked landmark and satellite-derived terrain

projects.headline: A psychedelic island, honestly rated.
projects.audience: For people building immersive worlds and VR.
projects.problem: Generated worlds pass validators long before they look like real places.
projects.promise: A procedural tropical island with daylight and nocturne variants, tested as the first step toward a Meta Quest VR world.
